candidates.claim: firstLoad waits on the read captured when it started, not the newest one, so a hung first settings read blocks the Default range move even after a newer read answers.
candidates.trigger: 1. Panel opens. firstLoad (panel.js:595) calls readDefaultRange, read 1 = p1 is set as pendingDefaultRead. 2. settings.get for read 1 stalls (no answer until the host deadline). 3. The 1500 ms timer (panel.js:599) fires load() with 7d, so state.report is set. 4. User changes Default range to 90d; onDidChange starts read 2 = p2 and it answers 90d (p2 clears pendingDefaultRead). 5. firstLoad is still awaiting p1 (the `await` at 601 uses the value captured before p2). 6. Only when p1 finally settles does firstLoad reach line 603-611 and move to 90d. Until then the panel shows 7d though the saved default is 90d.
candidates.wrong: Should: firstLoad acts on the newest answer as soon as it arrives. Now: it waits on the stale promise, so the move is delayed until the stalled read ends; if the stall is longer than the deadline, the move is skipped for the open.
candidates.confidence: medium; needs settings.get deadline length from the Orca shell to know how long the stall lasts (not read)
candidates.class: awaiting a captured promise instead of the latest shared promise
candidates.sweep: readDefaultRange (panel.js:618) and its only other reader firstLoad: checked-broken here. onDidChange path (panel.js:596) does not await, so checked-fine. Not checked: other loops on shared promises in panel.js.

candidates.claim: A Default range answer that lands while the person has the Custom date fields open moves the range under them and leaves the picker visible.
candidates.trigger: 1. Panel opens, setting read is slow (state.range 7d, rangePicked false). 2. User clicks Custom (panel.js:834-840): custom-range shown, rangePicked stays false, Custom button aria-checked unchanged. 3. Setting answers 30d. 4. firstLoad sets state.range = 30d and aria-checked moves to 30d (panel.js:606-607), and load() runs (panel.js:611). 5. Custom fields still visible with the start/end inputs; the 30d chip is checked.
candidates.wrong: Should: a Custom pick in progress is a pick (or the default move is skipped). Now: the default overrides it without closing the picker.
candidates.confidence: medium; the window is the settings read latency, so it is rare
candidates.class: a pick flag set only on some control paths
candidates.sweep: rangePicked is set at panel.js:296 (applyDates) and 844 (preset click); the Custom click at 834 returns before it. Checked: applyDates and preset paths are fine. Not checked: keyboard radio path (bindRadioKeys) for the same flag.
